description_en: Retrieves gateway information by calling GetGateway
name: GetGateway

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the gateway
parameters.name: gw_eui

Address.description_en: The detailed address where the gateway is located

AddressCode.description_en: The region ID where the gateway is located, as defined by http://lbs.amap.com/api/javascript-api/download

City.description_en: The name of the city where the gateway is located

ClassBSupported.description_en: Indicates whether the gateway supports Class B mode
ClassBSupported.description_zh: 该网关是否支持Class B模式

ClassBWorking.description_en: Indicates whether the gateway is currently working in Class B mode
ClassBWorking.description_zh: 该网关是否正工作在Class B模式下

CommunicationMode.description_en: The communication mode of the gateway. Valid values: FULL_DUPLEX (full-duplex), HALF_DUPLEX (half-duplex)
CommunicationMode.description_zh: 网关通信模式。可取值为：FULL_DUPLEX(全双工）、HALF_DUPLEX(半双工)

Description.description_en: The custom description of the gateway

District.description_en: The name of the district where the gateway is located

Enabled.description_en: Indicates whether the gateway is enabled
Enabled.description_zh: 该网关是否处于启用状态

FreqBandPlanGroupId.description_en: The frequency band ID of the gateway

GisCoordinateSystem.description_en: The coordinate system used for the longitude and latitude of the gateway. Valid values: WGS_84, GCJ_02
GisCoordinateSystem.description_zh: 网关经纬度所采用的坐标系统，可取值：WGS_84, GCJ_02

GwEui.description_en: The unique identifier of the gateway

Name.description_en: The custom name of the gateway

OnlineState.description_en: The online/offline status of the gateway. Valid values: ONLINE, OFFLINE
OnlineState.description_zh: 网关在离线状态。可取值为ONLINE, OFFLINE

OnlineStateChangedMillis.description_en:
The time when the online/offline status last changed.

The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
OnlineStateChangedMillis.description_zh:
最近一次在离线状态变更的时间。

格式为UNIX时间戳，以毫秒为单位

TimeCorrectable.description_en: Indicates whether the gateway can be used as a time calibration gateway
TimeCorrectable.description_zh: 该网关是否可以作为时间校准网关

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful
